CDS.meaning: The software for HPLC and GC systems. It runs the instrument and stores its results

CFR.meaning: The set of United States federal rules. Title 21 covers food and drugs

CS.meaning: Describes a drug that the DEA regulates. A CS ledger is the running record of each container, as Title 21 of the CFR, Part 1304, requires

DB9.meaning: A nine-pin serial connector, common on older instruments

DEA.meaning: The United States agency that regulates controlled substances

ERP.meaning: The business system for assets, orders and inventory

FDA.meaning: The United States agency that regulates drugs and how they are tested

GC.meaning: A method that separates the parts of a vapor sample

GC-MS.meaning: GC that also identifies each part by its mass

HPLC.meaning: A method that separates the parts of a liquid sample

IQ.meaning: The check that a system is installed as specified

LC-MS/MS.meaning: Liquid chromatography with two mass filters in a row. It measures trace amounts of a drug

LIMS.meaning: The system of record for samples and results

OQ.meaning: The check that a system works across its operating range

PQ.meaning: The check that a system performs as needed in real use
